episodes.title: Güneşten Daha Sıcak
episodes.summary: Önem builds a special unit to take on unsolved femicide cases, while Sude's unresolved trauma of the death of her father boils to the surface.

episodes.title: Bir Nefes Kadar Yakın
episodes.summary: When a pop star's body is found in a dumpster, Önem unit works to uncover her mysterious death. Sofia struggles to adapt to her new work life.

episodes.title: Göldeki Kadın
episodes.summary: A woman's body is found discarded in a lake, but when they find unusual procedures across her body, the forensic team is determined to find her identity.

episodes.title: Düğüm
episodes.summary: Önem crafts a detailed trap for the infamous "Sailor" killer — luring him in with his own game — only to discover that he's only one piece of the puzzle.

episodes.title: Dilsiz Şeytan Bölüm 1
episodes.summary: A swanky garden party is cut short when a pregnant woman is found dead in her home. It is assumed to be an act of suicide, but Önem knows better.

episodes.title: Dilsiz Şeytan Bölüm 2
episodes.summary: The Graveyard continues to search for the father of Yasemin's baby, using the narrative of a fictional — but familiar — story left on her laptop.

episodes.title: Belladonna Bölüm 1
episodes.summary: A doctor is stabbed after a brawl breaks out with the family of a chronically ill girl. But with an eyewitness to the murder, is it a cut and dry case?

episodes.title: Belladonna Bölüm 2
episodes.summary: The unit finds links between the missing test results from Aycan's hospital and a nearby holistic healing scheme, fronted by a cocky spiritual leader.

episodes.title: Hayırsız Ada Bölüm 1
episodes.summary: When a mysterious icebox containing the leg of a deceased woman shows up at the Graveyard, Önem and her team begin their hunt for her body… and her killer.

episodes.title: Hayırsız Ada Bölüm 2
episodes.summary: Crazed superfans and jealous girlfriends are added to the list of suspects, after the dismembered body of the actress is finally uncovered.

episodes.title: Nostos Algos Bölüm 1
episodes.summary: Chief Inspector Hasan begins to reconnect with his son, but struggles to balance his duty for justice with his emotional ties to his family.

episodes.title: Nostos Algos Bölüm 2
episodes.summary: New information around Bülent's whereabouts on the night of Seher's murder throws all suspicions out, but the truth has a funny way of coming to light.

episodes.title: Pandora’nın Kutusu
episodes.summary: After several women receive ominous packages at their homes, Önem and her unit reconnect to investigate, but an influencer's death complicates the case.

episodes.title: Melis’in Selamı Var
episodes.summary: While Önem pulls back the curtain on her victim's double life, Selin finds a troubling lead in a toxic online community filled with misogynistic posts.

episodes.title: Nefretin Sözlüğü
episodes.summary: Önem looks into the murder of an old friend, but the case takes a macabre turn when Berk finds fingerprints belonging to a woman believed dead.

episodes.title: Bir Numara
episodes.summary: As news outlets report on the box deliveries, Gökçe and Selin discover dozens of new victims. Önem and Serdar connect their case to a hospital cover-up.

episodes.title: Artemis’in Kuryeleri
episodes.summary: Serdar confronts Önem about the target on her back. The unit starts to untangle the secrets and resentments surrounding a factory engineer's death.

episodes.title: Siyah Kurdele
episodes.summary: The team pores over toxic online comments for clues about a missing surrogate. Hasan and Selin prepare for a high-stakes undercover operation.

episodes.title: Serra Nerede
episodes.summary: Önem, Gökçe and Hasan travel to İzmir to uncover the truth behind the murder of a hotel worker. Back in Istanbul, Serdar interrogates a critical suspect.

episodes.title: Celsus’un Terazisi
episodes.summary: With a woman's life hanging in the balance, Önem and her team piece together a decades-old vendetta that set the box delivery crimes in motion.
